en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses. He said,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,

es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Moisés. Le dijo:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés:

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinena na Musa. Akasema,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa,

decisions.choice: verse numbers follow the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: This chapter is numbered as in the Hebrew text. Hebrew 5:20-26 are numbered 6:1-7 in many Bibles, so Hebrew 6:1-23, the verses of this chapter, are 6:8-30 there, and the Hebrew chapter 7 begins at the same point in both. Leviticus is cited here by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: a new speech: instructions for the priests
decisions.reason: Chapters 1-5 told the people what to bring. From here to 7:38 the same offerings are taken up again, now with the rules the priests must follow for each (6:2, 7, 18; 7:1, 11).

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Leviticus, the lines of narration that introduce each speech use the tense of written narrative at Literal and Balanced and the spoken tense at Readable. The instructions themselves are in the future.

source.text: צַ֤ו אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָעֹלָ֑ה הִ֣וא הָעֹלָ֡ה עַל֩ מוֹקְדָ֨ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כָּל־הַלַּ֨יְלָה֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וְאֵ֥שׁ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תּ֥וּקַד בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, this [is the] law of the burnt offering: it [is] the burnt offering on [the] hearth on the altar all the night until the morning, and [the] fire of the altar will burn on it.

en.L: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This [is] the law of the burnt offering: it, the burnt offering, [shall be] on the hearth on the altar all the night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.
en.B: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: 'These are the instructions for the burnt offering. The burnt offering is to stay on the hearth of the altar all night, until morning, and the altar fire must be kept burning on it.
en.R: "Give Aaron and his sons this order: 'Here are the rules for the burnt offering. The burnt offering must stay on the fire on the altar all night long, until morning. The fire on the altar must keep burning.

es.L: «Manda a Aarón y a sus hijos, diciendo: “Esta [es] la ley del holocausto: el holocausto mismo [estará] sobre la hoguera, sobre el altar, toda la noche hasta la mañana, y el fuego del altar se mantendrá encendido en él.
es.B: «Da esta orden a Aarón y a sus hijos: “Estas son las instrucciones para el holocausto. El holocausto permanecerá sobre la hoguera del altar toda la noche, hasta la mañana, y el fuego del altar se mantendrá encendido.
es.R: «Ordénales a Aarón y a sus hijos: “Estas son las reglas del holocausto. El holocausto tiene que quedarse sobre el fuego del altar toda la noche, hasta la mañana. El fuego del altar tiene que seguir ardiendo.

fr.L: « Ordonne à Aaron et à ses fils, en disant : “Voici la loi de l’holocauste : l’holocauste lui-même [restera] sur le foyer, sur l’autel, toute la nuit jusqu’au matin, et le feu de l’autel y sera entretenu.
fr.B: « Donne cet ordre à Aaron et à ses fils : “Voici les instructions pour l’holocauste. L’holocauste restera sur le foyer de l’autel toute la nuit, jusqu’au matin, et le feu de l’autel y sera entretenu.
fr.R: « Dis à Aaron et à ses fils de faire ceci : “Voici les règles de l’holocauste. L’holocauste doit rester sur le feu de l’autel toute la nuit, jusqu’au matin. Le feu de l’autel doit continuer à brûler.

sw.L: "Mwamuru Haruni na wanawe, ukisema, 'Hii [ndiyo] sheria ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa: sadaka ya kuteketezwa yenyewe [itakaa] juu ya meko juu ya madhabahu usiku wote mpaka asubuhi, na moto wa madhabahu utaendelea kuwaka juu yake.
sw.B: "Wape Haruni na wanawe agizo hili: 'Haya ndiyo maelekezo kuhusu sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Sadaka ya kuteketezwa itakaa juu ya meko ya madhabahu usiku kucha mpaka asubuhi, na moto wa madhabahu utaendelea kuwaka juu yake.
sw.R: "Mwamuru Haruni na wanawe hivi: 'Haya ndiyo masharti ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Sadaka ya kuteketezwa lazima ikae juu ya moto wa madhabahu usiku kucha mpaka asubuhi. Moto wa madhabahu lazima uendelee kuwaka.

decisions.choice: law: instruction, the set procedure for a rite
decisions.reason: The word means teaching or instruction. In 6:2-7:37 it names the rules for one kind of offering, the way it is to be done, and each section opens with "This is the law of ..." (6:7, 18; 7:1, 11). The same pattern is used for the rules on uncleanness in chapters 11-15 (11:46; 12:7; 13:59).

decisions.choice: command: a stronger word than "speak"
decisions.reason: Chapters 1-5 opened "Speak to the sons of Israel"; this speech is a command to the priests, who are responsible for carrying it out.

decisions.choice: hearth: the place on the altar where the fire burns
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for burning and occurs only here. The burnt offering of the evening (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8) was to burn through the night on the altar fire.

decisions.choice: instructions / rules
decisions.reason: Balanced says "instructions" and Readable "rules" for this sense of the word. Literal keeps "law".

decisions.choice: this command / this order
decisions.reason: "Saying" introduces the words to be passed on; Balanced and Readable fold it into "give ... this command".

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L); "maelekezo" (B); "masharti" (R); hearth: "meko" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Kanuni" is kept for the word for a statute (3:17), so this word for a set procedure is "sheria" at Literal, with "maelekezo" (instructions) and "masharti" (rules) where the English says "instructions" and "rules". "Meko" is the place where a fire is kept (m3).

source.text: וְלָבַ֨שׁ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדּ֣וֹ בַ֗ד וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ עַל־בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וְהֵרִ֣ים אֶת־הַדֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֥ל הָאֵ֛שׁ אֶת־הָעֹלָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְשָׂמ֕וֹ אֵ֖צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will put on the priest his garment of linen, and undergarments of linen he will put on over his flesh, and he will lift up the fatty ash which consumes the fire, the burnt offering, on the altar, and he will place it beside the altar.

en.L: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and linen undergarments he shall put on over his flesh, and he shall lift up the fatty ashes [to] which the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
en.B: The priest is to put on his linen robe, with linen undergarments next to his body. Then he is to take up the ashes left when the fire has burned up the burnt offering on the altar, and put them beside the altar.
en.R: The priest must put on his linen robe and his linen underwear. Then he must take away the ashes left from the burnt offering that the fire burned up on the altar. He must put them beside the altar.

es.L: Y el sacerdote se pondrá su vestidura de lino, y se pondrá calzones de lino sobre su carne, y levantará las cenizas grasas [en que] el fuego ha consumido el holocausto sobre el altar, y las pondrá junto al altar.
es.B: El sacerdote se pondrá su vestidura de lino, con calzones de lino sobre el cuerpo. Luego recogerá las cenizas que quedan cuando el fuego ha consumido el holocausto sobre el altar, y las pondrá junto al altar.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que ponerse su vestidura de lino y su ropa interior de lino. Luego tiene que sacar las cenizas que quedan del holocausto que el fuego quemó sobre el altar. Tiene que ponerlas junto al altar.

fr.L: Et le prêtre revêtira son vêtement de lin, et il mettra des caleçons de lin sur sa chair, et il enlèvera les cendres grasses [auxquelles] le feu a réduit l’holocauste sur l’autel, et il les déposera à côté de l’autel.
fr.B: Le prêtre revêtira son vêtement de lin, avec des caleçons de lin à même le corps. Puis il enlèvera les cendres qui restent quand le feu a consumé l’holocauste sur l’autel, et les déposera à côté de l’autel.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit mettre son vêtement de lin et ses sous-vêtements de lin. Ensuite il doit enlever les cendres qui restent de l’holocauste que le feu a brûlé sur l’autel. Il doit les déposer à côté de l’autel.

sw.L: Na kuhani atavaa vazi lake la kitani, na suruali ya ndani ya kitani ataivaa juu ya mwili wake, naye atainua majivu ya mafuta ambayo moto umeiteketeza sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu, naye atayaweka kando ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Kuhani atavaa vazi lake la kitani, pamoja na suruali ya ndani ya kitani mwilini mwake. Kisha atayazoa majivu yaliyobaki baada ya moto kuiteketeza sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu, na kuyaweka kando ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Kuhani lazima avae vazi lake la kitani na nguo yake ya ndani ya kitani. Kisha lazima azoe majivu yaliyobaki ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo moto uliichoma juu ya madhabahu. Lazima ayaweke kando ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the fatty ashes: the ash of wood mixed with the fat of the offerings
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning "fat". It names what is left on the altar when the fire has burned the offerings and their fat: an oily ash. The same word is used of the ash heap east of the altar in 1:16 and of the place outside the camp in 4:12. It is not common rubbish: it is first set beside the altar and then carried to a clean place (verse 4).

decisions.choice: linen garment and undergarments: the priest's clothing for the altar
decisions.reason: Linen clothing for the priests is described in Exodus 28:39-43, where the linen undergarments are to cover the body "from the waist to the thighs" so that the priest is not exposed at the altar. The garment here may be the priest's tunic. Even taking away ashes is holy work and is done in holy clothing.

decisions.choice: which the fire consumes, the burnt offering: the ashes of the burnt offering after the fire has burned it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the ashes "which the fire consumes the burnt offering". The sense is the ash that is left when the fire has burned up the burnt offering.

decisions.choice: the ashes
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "fatty ashes", which shows the root; Balanced and Readable say "ashes" (1:16).

source.text: וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְלָבַ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־הַדֶּ֨שֶׁן֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל־מָק֖וֹם טָהֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will strip off his garments and put on other garments, and he will bring out the fatty ash to outside the camp, to a place clean.

en.L: And he shall take off his garments and put on other garments, and he shall bring out the fatty ashes to outside the camp, to a clean place.
en.B: Then he is to take off these clothes, put on other clothes, and carry the ashes out of the camp to a ceremonially clean place.
en.R: Then he must change into other clothes and carry the ashes outside the camp. He must take them to a place that is clean.

es.L: Y se quitará sus vestiduras y se pondrá otras vestiduras, y sacará las cenizas grasas fuera del campamento, a un lugar puro.
es.B: Luego se quitará esa ropa, se pondrá otra y llevará las cenizas fuera del campamento, a un lugar ritualmente puro.
es.R: Después tiene que cambiarse de ropa y sacar las cenizas fuera del campamento. Tiene que llevarlas a un lugar que esté puro.

fr.L: Et il ôtera ses vêtements et revêtira d’autres vêtements, et il emportera les cendres grasses hors du camp, dans un lieu pur.
fr.B: Puis il quittera ces vêtements, en mettra d’autres et emportera les cendres hors du camp, dans un lieu rituellement pur.
fr.R: Ensuite il doit changer de vêtements et porter les cendres hors du camp. Il doit les déposer dans un endroit pur.

sw.L: Naye atavua mavazi yake na kuvaa mavazi mengine, naye atayatoa majivu ya mafuta nje ya kambi, mpaka mahali safi.
sw.B: Kisha atavua mavazi hayo, avae mengine, na kuyapeleka majivu nje ya kambi, mahali palipo safi kwa taratibu za ibada.
sw.R: Kisha lazima abadilishe mavazi na kuyapeleka majivu nje ya kambi. Lazima ayapeleke mahali palipo safi.

decisions.choice: other garments: ordinary clothing for work outside the holy area
decisions.reason: The holy linen clothing belongs at the altar. To go out of the camp the priest changes into other clothes, keeping what is holy apart from what is common (compare 16:23-24 and Ezekiel 44:19).

decisions.choice: a clean place: a place fit for holy remains, as in 4:12
decisions.reason: The ashes of the offerings are not thrown just anywhere. They go to a place outside the camp that is ritually clean, the same place to which the remains of a sin offering are taken (4:12).

source.text: וְהָאֵ֨שׁ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד־בּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וּבִעֵ֨ר עָלֶ֧יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עֵצִ֖ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָרַ֤ךְ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ הָֽעֹלָ֔ה וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And the fire on the altar will burn on it; not will it be quenched, and will kindle on it the priest wood in the morning, in the morning, and he will arrange on it the burnt offering and make smoke on it [the] fats of the peace offerings.

en.L: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. And the priest shall kindle wood on it morning by morning, and he shall arrange the burnt offering on it and make the fat portions of the peace offerings smoke on it.
en.B: The fire on the altar must be kept burning and must not go out. Every morning the priest is to put more wood on it, lay out the burnt offering on it, and burn on it the fat from the peace offerings.
en.R: The fire on the altar must keep burning. It must not go out. Every morning the priest must add wood to the fire. He must place the burnt offering on it and burn the fat of the peace offerings there.

es.L: Y el fuego sobre el altar se mantendrá encendido en él; no se apagará. Y el sacerdote encenderá leña sobre él mañana tras mañana, y dispondrá sobre él el holocausto y hará humear sobre él las grasas de los sacrificios de paz.
es.B: El fuego del altar se mantendrá encendido y no deberá apagarse. Cada mañana el sacerdote le echará más leña, dispondrá sobre él el holocausto y hará subir en humo sobre él la grasa de los sacrificios de paz.
es.R: El fuego del altar tiene que seguir ardiendo. No debe apagarse. Cada mañana el sacerdote tiene que echarle leña al fuego. Tiene que poner el holocausto encima y quemar allí la grasa de los sacrificios de paz.

fr.L: Et le feu sur l’autel y sera entretenu ; il ne s’éteindra pas. Et le prêtre y fera brûler du bois matin après matin, et il y disposera l’holocauste et y fera fumer les graisses des sacrifices de communion.
fr.B: Le feu de l’autel sera entretenu et ne devra pas s’éteindre. Chaque matin, le prêtre y ajoutera du bois, y disposera l’holocauste et y fera monter en fumée la graisse des sacrifices de communion.
fr.R: Le feu sur l’autel doit continuer à brûler. Il ne doit pas s’éteindre. Chaque matin, le prêtre doit remettre du bois sur le feu. Il doit y placer l’holocauste et y brûler la graisse des sacrifices de communion.

sw.L: Na moto ulio juu ya madhabahu utaendelea kuwaka juu yake; hautazimika. Naye kuhani atawasha kuni juu yake kila asubuhi, naye ataipanga sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu yake na kufukiza juu yake shahamu ya sadaka za amani.
sw.B: Moto wa madhabahu utaendelea kuwaka na hautazimika. Kila asubuhi kuhani ataongeza kuni juu yake, kuipanga sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu yake, na kufukiza juu yake shahamu ya sadaka za amani.
sw.R: Moto ulio juu ya madhabahu lazima uendelee kuwaka. Usizimike. Kila asubuhi kuhani lazima aongeze kuni motoni. Lazima aweke sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu yake na kuchoma shahamu ya sadaka za amani hapo.

decisions.choice: in the morning, in the morning: every morning
decisions.reason: Repeating the phrase makes it distributive: each morning, day after day.

decisions.choice: the burnt offering and the fat of the peace offerings: the daily offerings burned on the morning fire
decisions.reason: The morning burnt offering (Exodus 29:38-39) was laid on the fresh wood, and the fat of any peace offerings brought that day was burned on top of it, as 3:5 says.

decisions.choice: make smoke: burn on the altar, so that it goes up as smoke
decisions.reason: The verb used for burning offerings on the altar means to turn them into smoke that rises to God (1:9). It is a different verb from the one for burning refuse outside the camp (verse 23).

source.text: אֵ֗שׁ תָּמִ֛יד תּוּקַ֥ד עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֹ֥א תִכְבֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A fire continually will burn on the altar; not will it be quenched.

en.L: A fire shall burn continually on the altar; it shall not go out.
en.B: Fire is to burn on the altar at all times, never going out.
en.R: There must always be a fire burning on the altar. No one may let it die out.

es.L: Un fuego arderá continuamente sobre el altar; no se apagará.
es.B: El fuego ha de arder sobre el altar en todo momento, sin apagarse nunca.
es.R: Siempre tiene que haber fuego encendido en el altar. Nadie debe dejar que se apague.

fr.L: Un feu brûlera continuellement sur l’autel ; il ne s’éteindra pas.
fr.B: Le feu doit brûler sur l’autel en permanence, sans jamais s’éteindre.
fr.R: Il doit toujours y avoir un feu allumé sur l’autel. Personne ne doit le laisser s’éteindre.

sw.L: Moto utawaka daima juu ya madhabahu; hautazimika.
sw.B: Moto utawaka juu ya madhabahu wakati wote, usizimike kamwe.
sw.R: Lazima moto uwake juu ya madhabahu wakati wote. Mtu yeyote asiuache uzimike.

decisions.choice: a fire continually: an altar fire that never goes out
decisions.reason: The fire first came from the LORD himself when the altar was dedicated (9:24). Keeping it always burning kept the offerings going up day and night, and it is stated twice (verses 5 and 6) for emphasis.

decisions.choice: No one may let it die out
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that this is a duty laid on the priests.

source.text: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤הּ בְּנֵֽי־אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is the] law of the grain offering: present it [the] sons of Aaron before Yahweh, to [the] front of the altar.

en.L: And this [is] the law of the grain offering: the sons of Aaron shall bring it near before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to the front of the altar.
en.B: These are the instructions for the grain offering. Aaron's sons are to present it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in front of the altar.
en.R: Here are the rules for the grain offering. Aaron's sons must bring it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of the altar.

es.L: Y esta [es] la ley de la ofrenda de cereal: los hijos de Aarón la presentarán delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, frente al altar.
es.B: Estas son las instrucciones para la ofrenda de cereal. Los hijos de Aarón la presentarán delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, frente al altar.
es.R: Estas son las reglas de la ofrenda de cereal. Los hijos de Aarón tienen que llevarla {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, delante del altar.

fr.L: Et voici la loi de l’offrande végétale : les fils d’Aaron la feront approcher devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sur le devant de l’autel.
fr.B: Voici les instructions pour l’offrande végétale. Les fils d’Aaron la présenteront devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, devant l’autel.
fr.R: Voici les règles de l’offrande végétale. Les fils d’Aaron doivent l’apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, devant l’autel.

sw.L: Na hii [ndiyo] sheria ya sadaka ya nafaka: wana wa Haruni wataisogeza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Haya ndiyo maelekezo kuhusu sadaka ya nafaka. Wana wa Haruni wataitoa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Haya ndiyo masharti ya sadaka ya nafaka. Wana wa Haruni lazima waipeleke kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the grain offering: the offering of 2:1-16, now from the priests' side
decisions.reason: The kinds of grain offering are described in chapter 2 (see 2:1). These verses tell the priests what to do with the portion burned and the part they eat.

decisions.choice: to the front of the altar: the west side, facing the tent
decisions.reason: The side of the altar that faces the tent of meeting, where offerings were set down before the priest took a handful to burn (2:8).

source.text: וְהֵרִ֨ים מִמֶּ֜נּוּ בְּקֻמְצ֗וֹ מִסֹּ֤לֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־הַלְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ רֵ֧יחַ נִיחֹ֛חַ אַזְכָּרָתָ֖הּ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will lift up from it in his handful from [the] fine flour of the grain offering and from its oil, and all the frankincense which [is] on the grain offering, and he will make smoke the altar, an aroma of soothing, its memorial portion to Yahweh.

en.L: And he shall lift from it in his handful some of the fine flour of the grain offering and some of its oil, and all the frankincense that [is] on the grain offering, and make [it] smoke [on] the altar, an aroma of soothing, its memorial portion to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The priest is to take up a handful of the fine flour of the grain offering with some of its oil, along with all the frankincense on it, and burn it on the altar as its memorial portion, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest must take a handful of the fine flour with some of its oil. He must also take all the frankincense on the grain offering. He must burn this on the altar. It is the part that is a reminder, a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y tomará de ella en su puñado parte de la flor de harina de la ofrenda de cereal y parte de su aceite, y todo el incienso que [está] sobre la ofrenda de cereal, y [la] hará humear [en] el altar, aroma grato, su porción memorial {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: El sacerdote tomará un puñado de la flor de harina de la ofrenda de cereal, con parte de su aceite y con todo el incienso que tiene encima, y lo hará subir en humo sobre el altar como porción memorial, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que tomar un puñado de la harina fina con un poco de su aceite. También tiene que tomar todo el incienso que está sobre la ofrenda de cereal. Tiene que quemarlo en el altar. Es la parte que sirve de recuerdo, de olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il en prélèvera dans sa poignée de la fleur de farine de l’offrande végétale et de son huile, et tout l’encens qui [est] sur l’offrande végétale, et il [la] fera fumer [sur] l’autel, odeur apaisante, sa portion commémorative pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le prêtre prendra une pleine poignée de la fleur de farine de l’offrande végétale avec un peu de son huile, ainsi que tout l’encens qui est dessus, et la fera monter en fumée sur l’autel comme portion commémorative, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit prendre une poignée de farine fine avec un peu de son huile. Il doit aussi prendre tout l’encens qui est sur l’offrande végétale. Il doit brûler cela sur l’autel. C’est la part qui sert de rappel, une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye atainua kutoka humo katika konzi yake sehemu ya unga laini wa sadaka ya nafaka na sehemu ya mafuta yake, na ubani wote ulio juu ya sadaka ya nafaka, naye atafukiza [juu ya] madhabahu, harufu ya kupendeza, sehemu yake ya ukumbusho kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kuhani atachukua konzi ya unga laini wa sadaka ya nafaka pamoja na sehemu ya mafuta yake, na ubani wote ulio juu yake, na kuvifukiza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sehemu yake ya ukumbusho, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kuhani lazima achukue konzi ya unga laini pamoja na sehemu ya mafuta yake. Lazima pia achukue ubani wote ulio juu ya sadaka ya nafaka. Lazima avichome juu ya madhabahu. Hii ndiyo sehemu ya kukumbusha, harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: his handful ... its memorial portion: as in 2:2
decisions.reason: The handful burned on the altar stands for the whole offering and is called its memorial portion (2:2). The rest goes to the priests (verse 9).

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: an offering that pleases God, as in 1:9
decisions.reason: The phrase describes the smoke of an offering that God accepts with pleasure (1:9).

decisions.choice: The priest
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he"; one of Aaron's sons (verse 7) does this. Balanced and Readable name him as "the priest".

source.text: וְהַנּוֹתֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔נָּה יֹאכְל֖וּ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו מַצּ֤וֹת תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ בַּחֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the remainder of it will eat Aaron and his sons; unleavened it will be eaten in a place holy; in [the] courtyard of [the] tent of meeting they will eat it.

en.L: And the remainder of it Aaron and his sons shall eat; [as] unleavened [bread] it shall be eaten, in a holy place; in the courtyard of the tent of meeting they shall eat it.
en.B: What is left of it belongs to Aaron and his sons as food. They must eat it as bread made without yeast, and in a holy place: the courtyard of the tent of meeting is where they must eat it.
en.R: Aaron and his sons may eat what is left. They must eat it as bread made without yeast. They must eat it in a holy place, in the courtyard of the meeting tent.

es.L: Y el resto de ella lo comerán Aarón y sus hijos; [como panes] sin levadura se comerá, en un lugar santo; en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro lo comerán.
es.B: Lo que quede de ella será alimento para Aarón y sus hijos. Lo comerán como pan sin levadura, y en un lugar santo: en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro tendrán que comerlo.
es.R: Aarón y sus hijos pueden comer lo que sobre. Tienen que comerlo como pan sin levadura. Tienen que comerlo en un lugar santo, en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Et le reste, Aaron et ses fils le mangeront ; on le mangera [en pains] sans levain, dans un lieu saint ; c’est dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre qu’ils le mangeront.
fr.B: Ce qui en reste revient à Aaron et à ses fils comme nourriture. Ils le mangeront sous forme de pains sans levain, et dans un lieu saint : c’est dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre qu’ils doivent le manger.
fr.R: Aaron et ses fils peuvent manger ce qui reste. Ils doivent le manger en pains sans levain. Ils doivent le manger dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Na kinachobaki chake Haruni na wanawe watakila; kitaliwa [kama mikate] isiyotiwa chachu, mahali patakatifu; katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania watakila.
sw.B: Kinachobaki ni chakula cha Haruni na wanawe. Watakila kama mikate isiyotiwa chachu, mahali patakatifu: katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania ndipo watakapokila.
sw.R: Haruni na wanawe wanaweza kula kinachobaki. Lazima wakile kama mikate isiyotiwa chachu. Lazima wakile mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: unleavened it shall be eaten: eaten as unleavened bread
decisions.reason: The priests' share is to be baked and eaten without leaven, like the offering itself (2:4, 11; verse 10).

decisions.choice: a holy place, the courtyard of the tent of meeting: within the holy area
decisions.reason: Because the offering is most holy (verse 10), it may not be taken home. It is eaten inside the courtyard around the tent, where only those who are holy may go.

source.text: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ חֶלְקָ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖הּ מֵאִשָּׁ֑י קֹ֤דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים֙ הִ֔וא כַּחַטָּ֖את וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will it be baked leavened; [as] their share I have given it from my fire offerings; a holy of holy things it [is], like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

en.L: It shall not be baked leavened. [As] their share I have given it from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} offerings by fire. It [is] a most holy [thing], like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.
en.B: It must not be baked with yeast. I have given it to them as their share of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} food offerings. It is most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.
en.R: It must not be baked with yeast. I have given it to the priests as their share of the food offerings burned for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. It is very holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.

es.L: No se cocerá con levadura. [Como] su porción se la he dado de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ofrendas quemadas. [Es] cosa santísima, como el sacrificio por el pecado y como el sacrificio por la culpa.
es.B: No se cocerá con levadura. Se la he dado como su porción de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ofrendas quemadas. Es santísima, como el sacrificio por el pecado y el sacrificio por la culpa.
es.R: No debe cocerse con levadura. Se la he dado a los sacerdotes como la parte que les toca de las ofrendas quemadas para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Es muy santa, como el sacrificio por el pecado y el sacrificio por la culpa.

fr.L: On ne la cuira pas avec du levain. [Comme] leur part, je la leur ai donnée de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} offrandes consumées par le feu. C’[est] une [chose] très sainte, comme le sacrifice pour le péché et comme le sacrifice de réparation.
fr.B: On ne la fera pas cuire avec du levain. Je la leur ai donnée comme leur part de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} offrandes consumées par le feu. C’est une chose très sainte, comme le sacrifice pour le péché et le sacrifice de réparation.
fr.R: On ne doit pas la cuire avec du levain. Je l’ai donnée aux prêtres comme leur part des offrandes brûlées pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. C’est très saint, comme le sacrifice pour le péché et le sacrifice de réparation.

sw.L: Haitaokwa pamoja na chachu. [Kuwa] fungu lao nimewapa kutoka katika sadaka {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za kuteketezwa kwa moto. [Ni] takatifu kabisa, kama sadaka ya dhambi na kama sadaka ya hatia.
sw.B: Haitaokwa pamoja na chachu. Nimewapa kuwa fungu lao la sadaka {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} za kuteketezwa kwa moto. Ni takatifu kabisa, kama sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka ya hatia.
sw.R: Isiokwe pamoja na chachu. Nimewapa makuhani kuwa fungu lao la sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Ni takatifu sana, kama sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka ya hatia.

decisions.choice: their share I have given: the priests' food is God's gift from what is his
decisions.reason: The offerings belong to God. He gives a share of them to the priests, who have no land of their own to farm (Numbers 18:8-20). Their food comes from his table.

decisions.choice: a holy of holy things: most holy, as in 2:3
decisions.reason: Most holy offerings may be eaten only by the priests, and only in the holy place (verses 9 and 11).

decisions.choice: like the sin offering and like the guilt offering
decisions.reason: The rules for those offerings follow in 6:17-23 and 7:1-7. All three are most holy and eaten by the priests in the same way.

decisions.choice: to the priests
decisions.reason: Readable names the priests as "them".

source.text: כָּל־זָכָ֞ר בִּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה חָק־עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Every male among [the] sons of Aaron will eat it, a portion forever for your generations from [the] fire offerings of Yahweh; all who touch them will become holy.

en.L: Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it, a portion forever for your generations from the offerings by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Whoever touches them will become holy.'"
en.B: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. It is their permanent share of the food offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for all your generations. Whoever touches these offerings will become holy.'"
en.R: Any male in Aaron's family may eat it. This will always be their share of the food offerings burned for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for all time to come. Anyone who touches these offerings will become holy.'"

es.L: Todo varón entre los hijos de Aarón la comerá, porción perpetua por {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} generaciones, de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Todo el que las toque quedará santificado”».
es.B: Cualquier varón descendiente de Aarón podrá comerla. Es su porción permanente de las ofrendas quemadas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, por todas {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} generaciones. Todo el que toque estas ofrendas quedará santificado”».
es.R: Cualquier varón de la familia de Aarón puede comerla. Siempre será la parte que les toca de las ofrendas quemadas para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por todos los tiempos. Cualquiera que toque estas ofrendas se volverá santo”».

fr.L: Tout mâle parmi les fils d’Aaron la mangera, part perpétuelle pour vos générations, [prise] sur les offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Quiconque les touchera deviendra saint.” »
fr.B: Tout descendant mâle d’Aaron pourra la manger. C’est leur part permanente des offrandes consumées par le feu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour toutes vos générations. Quiconque touchera ces offrandes deviendra saint.” »
fr.R: Tout homme de la famille d’Aaron peut la manger. Ce sera toujours leur part des offrandes brûlées pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour tous les temps à venir. Toute personne qui touche ces offrandes deviendra sainte.” »

sw.L: Kila mwanamume miongoni mwa wana wa Haruni ataila, fungu la kudumu milele katika vizazi vyenu, kutoka katika sadaka za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} za kuteketezwa kwa moto. Kila atakayezigusa atakuwa mtakatifu.'"
sw.B: Mwanamume yeyote wa uzao wa Haruni anaweza kuila. Ni fungu lao la kudumu la sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa vizazi vyenu vyote. Yeyote atakayezigusa sadaka hizi atakuwa mtakatifu.'"
sw.R: Mwanamume yeyote katika jamaa ya Haruni anaweza kuila. Hili litakuwa fungu lao daima la sadaka zilizochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa nyakati zote zijazo. Mtu yeyote atakayezigusa sadaka hizi atakuwa mtakatifu.'"

decisions.choice: a portion forever: a lasting share, not a statute
decisions.reason: The word here means a fixed portion or allowance. Joined to "forever" it names a share that is always to be theirs. A related word for a statute appears in 3:17; this is the priests' due.

decisions.choice: every male among the sons of Aaron: men of the priestly family
decisions.reason: Any male of Aaron's line may eat it, not only the priest on duty, so long as he is clean (compare 21:22). The women of the priests' households share only the less holy portions (10:14; 22:12-13).

decisions.choice: whoever touches them will become holy: holiness passes by touch
alternatives: whoever touches them must be holy
whatever touches them will become holy
decisions.reason: The verb can mean "will become holy" or "must be holy". Most holy things pass on their holiness, so that whoever touches them comes to belong to God's holy sphere and is bound by its rules (Exodus 29:37; 30:29). The phrase may also mean that only those already holy may touch them. The Hebrew can mean "whatever touches them" as well as "whoever".

decisions.choice: "porción perpetua" (L); "su porción permanente" (B); "siempre será la parte que les toca" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun here is a fixed share, not the statute of 3:17 (m1), so it is not "un estatuto perpetuo". The same phrase in verse 15 is "porción perpetua" too.

decisions.choice: "part perpétuelle" (L); "leur part permanente" (B); "toujours leur part" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun here is a fixed share, not the statute of 3:17 (m1), so it is not "une loi perpétuelle". The same phrase in verse 15 is "part perpétuelle" too.

decisions.choice: "fungu la kudumu milele" (L); "fungu lao la kudumu" (B); "fungu lao daima" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun here is a fixed share, not the statute of 3:17 (m1), so it is "fungu", not "kanuni". The same phrase in verse 15 is "fungu la kudumu milele" too.

decisions.choice: a new speech: the priests' own grain offering
decisions.reason: These verses (13-16) break into the instructions to deal with the grain offering the priests bring for themselves, which is not eaten.

source.text: זֶ֡ה קָרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָאֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת מִנְחָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מַחֲצִיתָ֣הּ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָ֖הּ בָּעָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is the] offering of Aaron and his sons which they will present to Yahweh on [the] day [when] he is anointed: a tenth of the ephah [of] fine flour, a grain offering continually, its half in the morning and its half in the evening.

en.L: "This [is] the offering of Aaron and his sons, which they shall bring near to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour [as] a grain offering continually, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
en.B: "This is the offering that Aaron and his sons are to present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the day he is anointed: {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half in the morning and half in the evening.
en.R: "Here is the offering that Aaron and his sons must bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the day he is anointed. They must bring {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour as a grain offering every day. Half of it must be offered in the morning and half in the evening.

es.L: «Esta [es] la ofrenda de Aarón y de sus hijos, que presentarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} el día en que él sea ungido: la décima parte de un efa de flor de harina [como] ofrenda de cereal perpetua, la mitad por la mañana y la mitad por la tarde.
es.B: «Esta es la ofrenda que Aarón y sus hijos presentarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde el día en que él sea ungido: {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de flor de harina como ofrenda de cereal regular, la mitad por la mañana y la mitad por la tarde.
es.R: «Esta es la ofrenda que Aarón y sus hijos tienen que traer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} desde el día en que él sea ungido. Tienen que traer cada día {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de harina fina como ofrenda de cereal. La mitad se ofrecerá por la mañana y la otra mitad por la tarde.

fr.L: « Voici l’offrande d’Aaron et de ses fils, qu’ils feront approcher {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} le jour où il recevra l’onction : un dixième d’épha de fleur de farine [en] offrande végétale perpétuelle, la moitié le matin et la moitié le soir.
fr.B: « Voici l’offrande qu’Aaron et ses fils présenteront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à partir du jour où il recevra l’onction : {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de fleur de farine, en offrande végétale régulière, la moitié le matin et la moitié le soir.
fr.R: « Voici l’offrande qu’Aaron et ses fils doivent apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à partir du jour où il recevra l’onction. Ils doivent apporter chaque jour {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de farine fine en offrande végétale. La moitié doit être offerte le matin, et l’autre moitié le soir.

sw.L: "Hii [ndiyo] sadaka ya Haruni na wanawe, watakayomsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku atakapopakwa mafuta: sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini [kuwa] sadaka ya nafaka daima, nusu yake asubuhi na nusu yake jioni.
sw.B: "Hii ndiyo sadaka ambayo Haruni na wanawe watamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu siku atakapopakwa mafuta: {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} ya unga laini kuwa sadaka ya nafaka ya kawaida, nusu asubuhi na nusu jioni.
sw.R: "Hii ndiyo sadaka ambayo Haruni na wanawe lazima wamletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} tangu siku atakapopakwa mafuta. Lazima walete kila siku {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} ya unga laini kuwa sadaka ya nafaka. Nusu yake itatolewa asubuhi na nusu nyingine jioni.

decisions.choice: on the day he is anointed: from that day on
alternatives: an offering on the day of anointing only
decisions.reason: "He" is the high priest, Aaron at first and then each son anointed after him (verse 15). The offering begins on the day of anointing and continues "continually", day by day. Some take the verse to mean an offering made by each priest on the day of his own anointing (compare 8:26-28), but "continually" and "morning and evening" point to a daily offering.

decisions.choice: a tenth of an ephah: about two quarts of flour, as in 5:11
decisions.reason: The ephah was a dry measure of grain; a tenth of it is the amount brought by the poorest worshiper in 5:11 and offered with each daily lamb (Exodus 29:40).

decisions.choice: continually: regularly, every day
decisions.reason: The same word is used of the burnt offering offered every morning and evening (Exodus 29:42) and of the fire that never goes out (verse 6).

decisions.choice: from the day
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "from" the day, which makes plain that the offering begins then and continues (see m1).

source.text: עַֽל־מַחֲבַ֗ת בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תְּבִיאֶ֑נָּה תֻּפִינֵי֙ מִנְחַ֣ת פִּתִּ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: On a griddle with oil it will be made; well mixed you will bring it; baked pieces of a grain offering of crumbs you will present, an aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: On a griddle with oil it shall be made; well soaked you shall bring it in; [as] baked pieces of a grain offering of broken bits you shall bring it near, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: It is to be made with oil on a griddle. Bring it in well soaked, and present it as a grain offering broken into pieces, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: It must be made with oil on a flat pan. Bring it when it is soaked through with oil. Break it into pieces and offer it as a grain offering. It is a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Sobre una plancha, con aceite, se hará; bien empapada la traerás; [en] trozos cocidos de una ofrenda de cereal en pedazos la presentarás, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Se preparará con aceite en la plancha. La traerás bien empapada y la presentarás como ofrenda de cereal partida en trozos, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Tiene que hacerse con aceite en una sartén plana. Tráela cuando esté bien empapada de aceite. Pártela en trozos y ofrécela como ofrenda de cereal. Es de olor agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Sur une plaque, avec de l’huile, elle sera faite ; tu l’apporteras bien imbibée ; [en] morceaux cuits d’une offrande végétale en miettes tu la feras approcher, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Elle sera préparée avec de l’huile sur la plaque. Tu l’apporteras bien imbibée et tu la présenteras en offrande végétale rompue en morceaux, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Elle doit être cuite avec de l’huile sur une poêle plate. Apporte-la quand elle est bien imbibée d’huile. Romps-la en morceaux et présente-la en offrande végétale. C’est une odeur qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Juu ya kikaango bapa pamoja na mafuta itafanywa; utaileta ikiwa imelowekwa vizuri; [kama] vipande vilivyookwa vya sadaka ya nafaka ya vipande vipande utaisogeza, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Itaandaliwa kwa mafuta juu ya kikaango bapa. Utaileta ikiwa imelowekwa vizuri, na kuitoa kuwa sadaka ya nafaka iliyomegwa vipande vipande, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lazima ipikwe kwa mafuta juu ya kikaango bapa. Ilete ikiwa imelowa mafuta kabisa. Imege vipande vipande na uitoe kuwa sadaka ya nafaka. Ni harufu inayompendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: well soaked: mixed thoroughly with oil
decisions.reason: The word is used only here, in 7:12 and in 1 Chronicles 23:29, always of flour and oil. It means flour that is soaked through, or dough well mixed, with oil.

decisions.choice: baked pieces: a word whose exact sense is unknown
decisions.reason: This word occurs nowhere else. From the context and the word "crumbs" or "broken bits" beside it, it seems to describe the cake baked and then broken in pieces, as with the griddle offering of 2:6. Others connect it with a word for baking, "baked" or "cooked".

decisions.choice: you will bring ... you will present: a word to the priest
decisions.reason: The speech turns to address the priest directly, as it does in 6:20 and 7:32.

decisions.choice: a flat pan
decisions.reason: Readable says "flat pan" for the griddle, a flat iron plate for baking (2:5).

source.text: וְהַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַמָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛יו מִבָּנָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ חָק־עוֹלָ֕ם לַיהוָ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל תָּקְטָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And the priest the anointed in his place from his sons will make it; a portion forever to Yahweh; wholly it will be made to smoke.

en.L: And the anointed priest who [is] in his place from among his sons shall make it, a portion forever to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it shall be made to smoke whole.
en.B: The son who succeeds him as the anointed priest is to prepare it. This is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s permanent due: it must be burned completely.
en.R: Each of Aaron's sons who becomes the high priest after him must offer it. It is always to be given to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. All of it must be burned up.

es.L: Y el sacerdote ungido que [esté] en su lugar, de entre sus hijos, la hará; porción perpetua para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; se hará humear entera.
es.B: El hijo que le suceda como sacerdote ungido la preparará. Es lo que corresponde {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} para siempre: se quemará por completo.
es.R: Cada hijo de Aarón que llegue a ser sumo sacerdote después de él tendrá que ofrecerla. Siempre se le dará {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Hay que quemarla toda.

fr.L: Et le prêtre oint qui [sera] à sa place, d’entre ses fils, la fera ; part perpétuelle pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; on la fera fumer entièrement.
fr.B: Celui de ses fils qui lui succédera comme prêtre oint la préparera. C’est ce qui revient pour toujours {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : elle sera brûlée tout entière.
fr.R: Chacun des fils d’Aaron qui deviendra grand prêtre après lui devra l’offrir. Elle sera toujours donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il faut la brûler tout entière.

sw.L: Na kuhani aliyepakwa mafuta atakayekuwa mahali pake kutoka miongoni mwa wanawe ataifanya; fungu la kudumu milele kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; itafukizwa yote.
sw.B: Mwanawe atakayemrithi kuwa kuhani aliyepakwa mafuta ataiandaa. Hili ni fungu la kudumu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: itateketezwa kabisa.
sw.R: Kila mwana wa Haruni atakayekuwa kuhani mkuu baada yake lazima aitoe. Itatolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima. Lazima ichomwe yote.

decisions.choice: the anointed priest: the high priest
decisions.reason: The "anointed priest" is the high priest, as in 4:3. This offering passes from Aaron to the son who takes his place in each generation.

decisions.choice: a portion forever to Yahweh: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: The phrase used of the priests' share in verse 11 is used here of what is due to the LORD: this offering is his entirely.

decisions.choice: wholly: as a whole offering, nothing left
decisions.reason: The word means "whole" or "complete"; it is used for an offering burned entirely (Deuteronomy 33:10; 1 Samuel 7:9).

decisions.choice: the high priest
decisions.reason: Readable names the anointed priest by his usual title.

source.text: וְכָל־מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן כָּלִ֥יל תִּהְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And every grain offering of a priest whole will be; not will it be eaten.

en.L: And every grain offering of a priest shall be whole; it shall not be eaten."
en.B: Every grain offering a priest brings for himself is to be burned whole; it must not be eaten."
en.R: Any grain offering that a priest brings for himself must be burned up completely. No one may eat it."

es.L: Y toda ofrenda de cereal de un sacerdote será entera; no se comerá».
es.B: Toda ofrenda de cereal que un sacerdote traiga por sí mismo se quemará entera; no se debe comer».
es.R: Cualquier ofrenda de cereal que un sacerdote traiga por sí mismo tiene que quemarse por completo. Nadie puede comerla».

fr.L: Et toute offrande végétale d’un prêtre sera entière ; on ne la mangera pas. »
fr.B: Toute offrande végétale qu’un prêtre apporte pour lui-même sera brûlée tout entière ; on ne doit pas la manger. »
fr.R: Toute offrande végétale qu’un prêtre apporte pour lui-même doit être entièrement brûlée. Personne ne doit la manger. »

sw.L: Na kila sadaka ya nafaka ya kuhani itakuwa nzima; haitaliwa."
sw.B: Kila sadaka ya nafaka ambayo kuhani anaitoa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe itateketezwa yote; haipaswi kuliwa."
sw.R: Sadaka yoyote ya nafaka ambayo kuhani anaileta kwa ajili yake mwenyewe lazima ichomwe kabisa. Mtu yeyote asiile."

decisions.choice: a priest's grain offering is not eaten
decisions.reason: When others bring a grain offering, the priest eats most of it (verse 9). He may not eat from his own offering: if he did, he would be giving nothing. So all of it goes to God.

decisions.choice: brings for himself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that this is an offering the priest brings on his own behalf.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Yahweh to Moses, saying,

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses, saying,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to Moses. He said,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses,

es.L: Y habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés, diciendo:
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habló a Moisés. Le dijo:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés:

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse, en disant :
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} parla à Moïse. Il dit :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse :

sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinena na Musa. Akasema,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa,

decisions.choice: a new speech, running on to 7:21
decisions.reason: This speech has no close before 7:21; the next new speech begins at 7:22. The instructions for the sin offering and guilt offering, and for the peace offering, belong to it.

source.text: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את בִּמְק֡וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הָעֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט הַֽחַטָּאת֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃

records.literal_gloss: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, this [is the] law of the sin offering: in [the] place where is slaughtered the burnt offering will be slaughtered the sin offering before Yahweh; a holy of holy things it [is].

en.L: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This [is] the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it [is] a most holy [thing].
en.B: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and tell them: 'These are the instructions for the sin offering. The sin offering is to be slaughtered before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the same place where the burnt offering is slaughtered. It is most holy.
en.R: "Tell Aaron and his sons: 'Here are the rules for the sin offering. Kill the animal for the sin offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, at the place where the animals for burnt offerings are killed. It is very holy.

es.L: «Habla a Aarón y a sus hijos, diciendo: “Esta [es] la ley del sacrificio por el pecado: en el lugar donde se degüella el holocausto se degollará el sacrificio por el pecado delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; [es] cosa santísima.
es.B: «Habla a Aarón y a sus hijos y diles: “Estas son las instrucciones para el sacrificio por el pecado. El sacrificio por el pecado se degollará delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en el mismo lugar donde se degüella el holocausto. Es santísimo.
es.R: «Diles a Aarón y a sus hijos: “Estas son las reglas del sacrificio por el pecado. Hay que matar al animal del sacrificio por el pecado delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en el lugar donde se matan los animales de los holocaustos. Es muy santo.

fr.L: « Parle à Aaron et à ses fils, en disant : “Voici la loi du sacrifice pour le péché : à l’endroit où l’on égorge l’holocauste, on égorgera le sacrifice pour le péché devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’[est] une [chose] très sainte.
fr.B: « Parle à Aaron et à ses fils et dis-leur : “Voici les instructions pour le sacrifice pour le péché. Le sacrifice pour le péché sera égorgé devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, au même endroit que l’holocauste. C’est une chose très sainte.
fr.R: « Dis à Aaron et à ses fils : “Voici les règles du sacrifice pour le péché. Il faut tuer l’animal du sacrifice pour le péché devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’endroit où l’on tue les animaux des holocaustes. C’est très saint.

sw.L: "Sema na Haruni na wanawe, ukisema, 'Hii [ndiyo] sheria ya sadaka ya dhambi: mahali ambapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjwa, sadaka ya dhambi itachinjwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [ni] takatifu kabisa.
sw.B: "Sema na Haruni na wanawe, uwaambie, 'Haya ndiyo maelekezo kuhusu sadaka ya dhambi. Sadaka ya dhambi itachinjwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali pale pale ambapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjwa. Ni takatifu kabisa.
sw.R: "Waambie Haruni na wanawe, 'Haya ndiyo masharti ya sadaka ya dhambi. Mnyama wa sadaka ya dhambi lazima achinjwe mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mahali wanapochinjwa wanyama wa sadaka za kuteketezwa. Ni takatifu sana.

decisions.choice: the sin offering: the purification offering of chapter 4, as in 4:3
decisions.reason: The rules for bringing it were given in 4:1-5:13. Here the priests learn where it is killed, who eats it, and how to deal with what touches it.

decisions.choice: the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered: north of the altar
decisions.reason: That place is "on the north side of the altar" (1:11). The sin offering is killed in the same holy place.

decisions.choice: most holy: as in verse 10
decisions.reason: Like the grain offering, the sin offering may be eaten only by the priests, in the holy place (verses 19 and 22).

decisions.choice: kill
decisions.reason: Readable says "kill" for the word for slaughtering an animal for sacrifice.

decisions.choice: "Il faut tuer l'animal"
decisions.reason: The English Readable uses a command ("Kill the animal"). French Readable uses the impersonal "il faut", which the Hebrew passive allows, so that the instructions to Aaron and his sons do not shift between "tu" and "vous" (verse 20 has a singular "you"). Spanish says "Hay que" and Swahili uses a passive with "lazima" for the same reason.

source.text: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽמְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ יֹאכֲלֶ֑נָּה בְּמָק֤וֹם קָדֹשׁ֙ תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל בַּחֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: The priest who offers it for sin will eat it; in a place holy it will be eaten, in [the] courtyard of [the] tent of meeting.

en.L: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it; in a holy place it shall be eaten, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
en.B: The priest who offers it for sin is to eat it. It must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.
en.R: The priest who offers the sin offering must eat it. It must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the meeting tent.

es.L: El sacerdote que lo ofrece por el pecado lo comerá; en un lugar santo se comerá, en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: El sacerdote que lo ofrece por el pecado lo comerá. Deberá comerse en un lugar santo, en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: El sacerdote que ofrece el sacrificio por el pecado tiene que comerlo. Hay que comerlo en un lugar santo, en el atrio de la Tienda del Encuentro.

fr.L: Le prêtre qui l’offre pour le péché le mangera ; on le mangera dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Le prêtre qui l’offre pour le péché le mangera. Il devra être mangé dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Le prêtre qui offre le sacrifice pour le péché doit le manger. Il faut le manger dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente de la Rencontre.

sw.L: Kuhani anayeitoa kwa ajili ya dhambi ataila; italiwa mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Kuhani anayeitoa kwa ajili ya dhambi ataila. Itapaswa kuliwa mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Kuhani anayetoa sadaka ya dhambi lazima aile. Lazima iliwe mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.

decisions.choice: who offers it for sin: who performs the purification rite with it
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word for sin and means to cleanse from sin, to perform the sin offering. The priest who does so receives the meat (compare 10:17, where eating it is part of bearing the people's guilt).

decisions.choice: in a holy place: as in verse 9
decisions.reason: The courtyard of the tent, as for the grain offering (verse 9).

source.text: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּ֥ע בִּבְשָׂרָ֖הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִזֶּ֤ה מִדָּמָהּ֙ עַל־הַבֶּ֔גֶד אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ תְּכַבֵּ֖ס בְּמָק֥וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: All that touches its flesh will become holy, and [one] who spatters some of its blood on the garment, what he spatters on it you will wash in a place holy.

en.L: Everything that touches its flesh will become holy; and when some of its blood spatters on a garment, what it spattered on you shall wash in a holy place.
en.B: Whatever touches its meat will become holy. If any of its blood spatters on a garment, you must wash the stained part in a holy place.
en.R: Anything that touches the meat will become holy. If any blood splashes on a piece of clothing, you must wash it in a holy place.

es.L: Todo lo que toque su carne quedará santificado; y cuando parte de su sangre salpique sobre una vestidura, lo que salpicó lo lavarás en un lugar santo.
es.B: Todo lo que toque su carne quedará santificado. Si algo de su sangre salpica una prenda, lavarás la parte manchada en un lugar santo.
es.R: Cualquier cosa que toque la carne se volverá santa. Si cae sangre sobre una prenda de ropa, tienes que lavarla en un lugar santo.

fr.L: Tout ce qui touchera sa chair deviendra saint ; et quand de son sang aura giclé sur un vêtement, ce sur quoi il a giclé, tu le laveras dans un lieu saint.
fr.B: Tout ce qui touchera sa viande deviendra saint. Si de son sang éclabousse un vêtement, tu laveras l’endroit taché dans un lieu saint.
fr.R: Tout ce qui touche la viande deviendra saint. Si du sang éclabousse un vêtement, tu dois le laver dans un lieu saint.

sw.L: Kila kitu kitakachogusa nyama yake kitakuwa kitakatifu; na damu yake ikirukia vazi, kile ilichorukia utakiosha mahali patakatifu.
sw.B: Chochote kitakachogusa nyama yake kitakuwa kitakatifu. Damu yake ikirukia vazi, utaiosha sehemu iliyoingia doa mahali patakatifu.
sw.R: Kitu chochote kinachogusa nyama hiyo kitakuwa kitakatifu. Damu ikirukia nguo, lazima uioshe mahali patakatifu.

decisions.choice: everything that touches its flesh will become holy: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: The meat is most holy, and what touches it shares that holiness. A garment stained with its blood must therefore be washed inside the holy area, not taken out of it. See the note on verse 11.

decisions.choice: spatters: falls by accident
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the priest's sprinkling of blood (4:6), but here it means drops that fall by accident, as the person who sprinkles would make them, on a garment.

decisions.choice: spatters / splashes
decisions.reason: Elsewhere this verb is "sprinkle", a deliberate act (4:6). Here it is an accident, so all levels say "spatter", and Readable "splash".

source.text: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל־בּ֖וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְאִם־בִּכְלִ֤י נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה וּמֹרַ֥ק וְשֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And a vessel of earthenware in which it is boiled will be broken; and if in a vessel of bronze it was boiled, then it will be scoured and rinsed with water.

en.L: And an earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured and rinsed with water.
en.B: Any clay pot it is boiled in must be broken. If it is boiled in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
en.R: If the meat is cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be broken. If it is cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.

es.L: Y la vasija de barro en que se cueza será quebrada; y si se coció en una vasija de bronce, será fregada y enjuagada con agua.
es.B: Toda olla de barro en que se cueza tendrá que romperse. Si se cuece en una olla de bronce, la olla se fregará y se enjuagará con agua.
es.R: Si la carne se cocina en una olla de barro, hay que romper la olla. Si se cocina en una olla de bronce, hay que fregarla y enjuagarla con agua.

fr.L: Et le vase de terre dans lequel elle aura été bouillie sera brisé ; et si elle a été bouillie dans un vase de bronze, il sera récuré et rincé à l’eau.
fr.B: Tout pot en terre où elle aura cuit devra être brisé. Si elle a cuit dans un pot de bronze, on récurera le pot et on le rincera à l’eau.
fr.R: Si la viande a cuit dans une marmite en terre, il faut casser la marmite. Si elle a cuit dans une marmite en bronze, il faut la récurer et la rincer avec de l’eau.

sw.L: Na chombo cha udongo ambacho itapikwa ndani yake kitavunjwa; na ikiwa ilipikwa katika chombo cha shaba, kitasuguliwa na kusuuzwa kwa maji.
sw.B: Chungu chochote cha udongo itakachopikiwa lazima kivunjwe. Ikipikwa katika sufuria ya shaba, sufuria hiyo itasuguliwa na kusuuzwa kwa maji.
sw.R: Nyama ikipikwa katika chungu cha udongo, chungu hicho lazima kivunjwe. Ikipikwa katika sufuria ya shaba, sufuria hiyo lazima isuguliwe na kusuuzwa kwa maji.

decisions.choice: earthenware ... bronze: clay soaks up what is cooked in it; metal can be cleaned
decisions.reason: Unglazed clay absorbs the juices of what is cooked in it, so a holy thing cannot be fully removed and the pot is broken. A metal pot can be scoured clean. The same rule applies to clay pots made unclean (11:33; 15:12).

records.literal_gloss: Every male among the priests will eat it; a holy of holy things it [is].

en.L: Every male among the priests shall eat it; it [is] a most holy [thing].
en.B: Any male of priestly descent may eat it. It is most holy.
en.R: Any male in the priests' families may eat it. It is very holy.

es.L: Todo varón entre los sacerdotes lo comerá; [es] cosa santísima.
es.B: Cualquier varón de familia sacerdotal podrá comerlo. Es santísimo.
es.R: Cualquier varón de las familias de los sacerdotes puede comerlo. Es muy santo.

fr.L: Tout mâle parmi les prêtres en mangera ; c’[est] une [chose] très sainte.
fr.B: Tout homme de famille sacerdotale pourra en manger. C’est une chose très sainte.
fr.R: Tout homme des familles des prêtres peut en manger. C’est très saint.

sw.L: Kila mwanamume miongoni mwa makuhani ataila; [ni] takatifu kabisa.
sw.B: Mwanamume yeyote wa ukoo wa makuhani anaweza kuila. Ni takatifu kabisa.
sw.R: Mwanamume yeyote katika jamaa za makuhani anaweza kuila. Ni takatifu sana.

decisions.choice: every male among the priests: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: Verse 19 says the priest who offers it eats it. This verse adds that he may share it with the other males of the priestly families.

records.literal_gloss: And any sin offering which is brought some of its blood into [the] tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place, not will it be eaten; with fire it will be burned.

en.L: And any sin offering of which some of its blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire.
en.B: But no sin offering is to be eaten if any of its blood has been brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place. It must be burned in the fire.
en.R: But some sin offerings must not be eaten. If any of the animal's blood is brought inside the meeting tent to make atonement in the holy place, the meat must be burned up.

es.L: Y ningún sacrificio por el pecado del cual se haya llevado parte de su sangre a la Tienda del Encuentro para hacer expiación en el lugar santo se comerá; será quemado en el fuego.
es.B: Pero no se comerá ningún sacrificio por el pecado si parte de su sangre se ha llevado a la Tienda del Encuentro para hacer expiación en el lugar santo. Se quemará en el fuego.
es.R: Pero algunos sacrificios por el pecado no se deben comer. Si se lleva parte de la sangre del animal dentro de la Tienda del Encuentro para hacer expiación en el lugar santo, la carne tiene que quemarse.

fr.L: Et aucun sacrifice pour le péché dont on aura apporté du sang dans la tente de la Rencontre pour faire l’expiation dans le lieu saint ne sera mangé ; il sera brûlé au feu.
fr.B: Mais on ne mangera aucun sacrifice pour le péché dont une partie du sang a été apportée dans la tente de la Rencontre pour faire l’expiation dans le lieu saint. Il sera brûlé au feu.
fr.R: Mais certains sacrifices pour le péché ne doivent pas être mangés. Si une partie du sang de l’animal est apportée à l’intérieur de la tente de la Rencontre pour faire l’expiation dans le lieu saint, la viande doit être brûlée.

sw.L: Na sadaka yoyote ya dhambi ambayo sehemu ya damu yake inaletwa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kufanya upatanisho katika mahali patakatifu haitaliwa; itachomwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Lakini sadaka yoyote ya dhambi haitaliwa ikiwa sehemu ya damu yake imeletwa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kufanya upatanisho katika mahali patakatifu. Itachomwa motoni.
sw.R: Lakini sadaka nyingine za dhambi hazipaswi kuliwa. Ikiwa sehemu ya damu ya mnyama inaletwa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania ili kufanya upatanisho katika mahali patakatifu, nyama lazima ichomwe yote.

decisions.choice: blood brought into the tent of meeting: the sin offerings of 4:3-21
decisions.reason: For the sin of the anointed priest or of the whole community, blood was taken into the tent and sprinkled before the veil (4:5-7, 16-18). Those animals were burned outside the camp (4:11-12, 21). The priests may eat only the sin offerings whose blood is put on the altar outside (4:25, 30). Moses later rebukes Aaron's sons for not eating one of these (10:16-18).

decisions.choice: to make atonement: as in 1:4
decisions.reason: The blood is brought in to make atonement for the priest or for the whole community (4:3, 13).

decisions.choice: the holy place: the holy room of the tent
decisions.reason: Here "the holy" is the outer room of the tent, where the blood is sprinkled before the veil (4:6), not the inner room behind it.

decisions.choice: burned: destroyed by fire
decisions.reason: This is the ordinary verb for burning, not the verb used for offerings made to smoke on the altar (verse 5).

decisions.choice: But some sin offerings must not be eaten
decisions.reason: Readable states the rule first and then which offerings it covers.
